report:
Order events on CDC (Postgresql, JDBC)

I have a source connector and sink connector with following configuration:
{
    "name": "sink_connector",
    "config": {
        "connector.class": "io.debezium.connector.jdbc.JdbcSinkConnector",
        "auto.create": "true",
        "insert.mode": "upsert",
        "schema.evolution": "basic",
        "table.name.format":"${source.schema}.${source.table}",
        "primary.key.mode": "record_key",
        "delete.enabled": "true",
        "topics.regex": "^test\\..*",
        "connection.url": "connection",
        "connection.username": "user",
        "connection.password": "pass",
        "tasks.max":3
    }
}
{
  "name": "source_connector",
  "config": {
    "connector.class": "io.debezium.connector.postgresql.PostgresConnector",
    "plugin.name":"pgoutput",
    "decimal.handling.mode": "double",
    "topic.creation.default.max.message.bytes": 150485760,
    "topic.creation.default.replication.factor": 1,
    "topic.creation.default.partitions":1,
    "topic.creation.default.retention.ms": 604800000,
    "snapshot.mode": "never",
    "topic.prefix": "test",
    "database.hostname": "hostname",
    "database.port": "port",
    "database.user": "user",
    "database.password": "pass",
    "database.dbname" : "dbname",
    "slot.name":"slot_name",
    "publication.name":"publication_name"
    }
}
In source database, there are tables X that is referenced by Y. There are events that insert Into X (let's call this X-Event), then insert into Y (the data that is inserted referenced to X, let's call this Y-Event). When i check my connector status, i found that my connector has failed, as it tries to process Y-Event (Foreign Key Violations). When i check in DB, it turns out X-Event hasn't been processed. What might have happened?

evidence.quote: Kafka only guarantees ordering within a single partition ... You can configure the source to send the events for X and Y into the same topic with a single partition, and then consume ... with a single task.

notes: FK violation in sink looks like lost/misordered events, but tables go to separate topics consumed by 3 tasks; cross-topic ordering is not guaranteed by design.
